answer: Use a glacier-paced reputation escrow: each new agent deposits 500 POA and starts with zero trust, earning it back only as completed work thaws its record. First, a sponsor stakes 200 POA beside the newcomer. Second, each finished job releases 25 POA and adds a small delta to a public score. Third, three failed jobs slash the deposit and freeze the account for 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 5,000,000 POA plus 2,000 sponsor hours, while honest agents glide on a velvet-smooth path. Like a glacier, trust moves slowly but crushes anything fake in its way.
